item.title: Thirty-one NHS trusts in England warn of 'unpalatable' cuts
item.body: Dozens of hospitals in England are so short of money they may not be able to continue caring for patients, the Guardian has revealed. Thirty-one trusts have warned that NHS cost-cutting demands threaten their ability to function normally.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏥 Thirty-one NHS trusts in England warn of 'unpalatable' cuts

Dozens of hospitals in England are so short of money they may not be able to continue caring for patients, the Guardian has revealed. Thirty-one trusts have warned that NHS cost-cutting demands threaten their ability to function normally.
